scope: Pre-score preparation and fixed quarter-TTS endpoint sampling protocol. Training-only source WAVs, no waveform transformation or detector inference.
selection: Every original training TTS-negative view from the retained CE recipe, including original and environmental views. Exclude heldout hashes and any training-positive source hash. No teacher scores or source filtering.
source_interval: Original16kHz mono PCM16;10ms RMS blocks; first/last block RMS>=max(peak*.01,1). Endpoints ceil((2.4+first+.03)/.08) through ceil((2.4+last+.32)/.08), inclusive, inside original warmed range25..frames. Silent or invalid sources fail preparation, never disappear silently.
training_intervention: One quarter of the48TTS-negative ends per batch, positions0,4,..44before original batch permutation. Consume every original RNG draw first, then use separate seed741+3000000for an interval end on the SAME source. Positives32,ambient48,other36TTS histories and all source/class draws must remain identical. No mining or other sampler change.
training_protocol: Retained initial weights and CE.2,extra-binary0,engine-adversary0,seed741,10000steps/final checkpoint,unchanged original auxiliary manifest,loss,learning-rate schedule and512PTQ histories. Bind prepared manifest in new plans before fitting. Off control must exactly reproduce retained model and main/auxiliary batch bytes.
evaluation: Original19point validation grid, retain joint confidence/confuser point and confidence-only diagnostic. The1%near-word constraint is additional research, not demonstrated HiESP parity; later matched native/acoustic/continuous comparisons remain necessary.
decision_gate: Compare under original fixed joint constraints; retain confidence-only alternatives and every grid row. An inferior intervention is not a board or final-evaluation candidate.
limits: Endpoint position inside an energy span does not prove speech occupancy;16embedding histories retain earlier speech outside it.
Source energy/RMS and synthetic metadata are not phonetic ground truth.
Same synthetic views/reused validation do not establish independent speakers, real recall or HiESP parity.
